models_evaluated: BERT-based hierarchical model with speaker-role embeddings

links.outcome: Triage accuracy of developed models versus GPT-4o and ClinicalBERT on same test data
links.effect: Hierarchical model accuracy 75.94% vs ChatGPT 56.68% and fine-tuned ClinicalBERT 69.42%; urgent-case recall 0.9610 vs ChatGPT 0.5352.
links.quote: Our model with hierarchical structure achieved accuracies of 75.94%, significantly outperforming ChatGPT (56.68%) or fine-tuned ClinicalBERT (69.42%).

unlisted_practices: Training triage models on real-world clinical conversations with speaker-role embeddings rather than summarized scenarios
SHAP-based explainability analysis to confirm models focus on clinically relevant cues

screen.reason: Evaluates BERT-based models and GPT-4o on a retrospective benchmark dataset of triage conversations to predict acuity without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
